dialogues.title: Giving difficult feedback
dialogues.scene: 经理与下属一对一面谈

lines.en: Thanks for making time, Daniel. I wanted to talk about how the product launch went from your perspective.
lines.zh: 谢谢你抽出时间，丹尼尔。我想听听从你的角度看，产品发布进行得怎么样。

lines.en: Honestly, I think it went reasonably well, given how tight the timeline was.
lines.zh: 说实话，考虑到时间那么紧，我觉得还算顺利。

lines.en: I agree the end result was solid. What I'd like to unpack is the communication with the design team along the way.
lines.zh: 我同意最终结果不错。我想仔细谈谈的是过程中你和设计团队的沟通。

lines.en: Has someone raised a concern?
lines.zh: 有人提出意见了吗？

lines.en: A couple of people mentioned that changes were being made without them being looped in, which meant some of their work had to be redone.
lines.zh: 有几个人提到，修改时没有通知他们，导致他们的部分工作只能返工。

lines.en: That's fair, actually. I was so focused on hitting the deadline that I cut corners on keeping everyone informed.
lines.zh: 这么说其实没错。我太专注于赶截止日期，在通知大家这件事上偷了懒。

lines.en: I appreciate you owning that. It's an easy trap to fall into under pressure.
lines.zh: 感谢你愿意承担。压力之下很容易掉进这个坑。

lines.en: Would it help if I set up a short weekly sync with design for the next project?
lines.zh: 下一个项目我和设计团队每周开个简短的同步会，会有帮助吗？

lines.en: That would go a long way. And it might be worth checking in with them now, just to clear the air.
lines.zh: 那会很有帮助。也许现在就和他们聊聊，把误会说开。

lines.en: I'll do that this afternoon. Thanks for being straight with me.
lines.zh: 我今天下午就去。谢谢你对我直言不讳。

dialogues.title: Debating remote work
dialogues.scene: 两位同事讨论公司回归办公室的政策

lines.en: Did you see the email? Management wants everyone back in the office four days a week from January.
lines.zh: 你看到邮件了吗？管理层要求从一月起每周四天回办公室。

lines.en: I did. To be honest, I'm not entirely opposed to it. I've found it hard to switch off at home.
lines.zh: 看到了。老实说，我并不完全反对。我发现在家很难真正下班。

lines.en: I get that, but for those of us with long commutes, it's an extra ten hours a week on the train.
lines.zh: 我理解，但对我们这些通勤很远的人来说，每周要在火车上多花十个小时。

lines.en: That's a fair point. Still, I think junior staff in particular lose out when nobody's around to learn from.
lines.zh: 这一点说得对。不过我认为，尤其是新员工，身边没人可以请教时损失最大。

lines.en: Granted, but that could be addressed by having teams agree on two shared days rather than imposing a blanket rule.
lines.zh: 这我承认，但可以让各团队商定两个共同到岗日来解决，而不是一刀切。

lines.en: Mm, I suppose a one-size-fits-all policy does ignore the fact that different roles have different needs.
lines.zh: 嗯，一刀切的政策确实忽视了不同岗位需求不同这一事实。

lines.en: Exactly. And there's a real risk we'll lose good people to competitors who offer more flexibility.
lines.zh: 正是。而且我们真的有可能把优秀员工流失给那些更灵活的竞争对手。

lines.en: Why don't we put together some feedback for the staff forum next week? A constructive proposal is more likely to be heard than a complaint.
lines.zh: 要不我们为下周的员工论坛整理一些反馈？建设性的提议比抱怨更可能被听进去。

lines.en: Good idea. Let's draft something tomorrow.
lines.zh: 好主意。我们明天起草一份吧。

dialogues.title: Planning a surprise party
dialogues.scene: 两个朋友为共同好友筹备派对

lines.en: So, have you managed to track down a venue for Hannah's thirtieth?
lines.zh: 汉娜三十岁生日的场地你找到了吗？

lines.en: Sort of. There's a room above a pub in town that's free on the fourteenth, but it only holds about forty people.
lines.zh: 算是吧。城里一家酒吧楼上有个房间14号有空，但只能容纳四十人左右。

lines.en: That might be cutting it fine. The guest list is already pushing fifty.
lines.zh: 那可能有点紧。宾客名单已经快五十人了。

lines.en: We could always trim it down. Not everyone on there is that close to her.
lines.zh: 我们总可以删减一些。名单上不是每个人都跟她那么亲近。

lines.en: True, but I'd rather not risk offending anyone. What about her sister's garden as a backup?
lines.zh: 没错，但我不想冒得罪人的风险。要不把她姐姐家的花园作为备选？

lines.en: In November? We'd be at the mercy of the weather.
lines.zh: 十一月？那我们就得看天气脸色了。

lines.en: Fair. OK, let's book the pub room and keep the list tight. The bigger issue is keeping it a secret.
lines.zh: 也对。好吧，就订酒吧的房间，把名单控制好。更大的问题是保密。

lines.en: Leave that to me. I'll tell her we're just going out for a quiet drink, the two of us.
lines.zh: 交给我吧。我就跟她说只是我们俩出去安静地喝一杯。

lines.en: Perfect. Just don't let it slip — you're notoriously bad at keeping secrets.
lines.zh: 完美。只是别说漏嘴——你保守秘密的能力是出了名的差。

dialogues.title: A medical consultation
dialogues.scene: 病人与医生讨论治疗方案

lines.en: Your blood test results are back. Your cholesterol is on the high side, though not dangerously so.
lines.zh: 你的验血结果出来了。胆固醇偏高，不过还不到危险的程度。

lines.en: Does that mean I'll need to go on medication?
lines.zh: 这是不是意味着我得吃药了？

lines.en: Not necessarily. At this stage, I'd generally recommend trying lifestyle changes for three months first.
lines.zh: 不一定。现阶段我一般建议先尝试三个月的生活方式调整。

lines.en: What sort of changes are we talking about?
lines.zh: 需要做哪些改变？

lines.en: Cutting back on saturated fat, eating more fibre, and aiming for at least 150 minutes of moderate exercise a week.
lines.zh: 减少饱和脂肪，多吃膳食纤维，并争取每周至少150分钟的中等强度运动。

lines.en: I'll be honest, the exercise is where I usually struggle.
lines.zh: 说实话，运动是我通常最难坚持的。

lines.en: It doesn't have to be the gym. Brisk walking counts, as does cycling to work.
lines.zh: 不一定要去健身房。快走也算，骑车上班也算。

lines.en: That sounds more manageable. And if the numbers haven't improved after three months?
lines.zh: 这听起来更可行。那如果三个月后指标没有改善呢？

lines.en: Then we'd discuss medication, weighing up the benefits against any side effects. But many people see a real difference.
lines.zh: 那我们再讨论用药，权衡其好处和副作用。不过很多人都会看到明显改善。

dialogues.title: Pitching an idea
dialogues.scene: 创业者向投资人做简短陈述

lines.en: Every year, supermarkets throw away millions of tonnes of food that's still perfectly edible.
lines.zh: 每年，超市都会扔掉数百万吨仍然完全可以食用的食物。

lines.en: Our app connects stores with local customers who can buy that surplus at a steep discount before closing time.
lines.zh: 我们的应用把商店和本地顾客连接起来，让顾客能在关门前以大幅折扣购买这些剩余食品。

lines.en: There are already a few players in this space. What sets you apart?
lines.zh: 这个领域已经有几家公司了。你们有什么不同？

lines.en: We integrate directly with stores' stock systems, so listings update automatically — staff don't have to do anything manually.
lines.zh: 我们直接对接商店的库存系统，商品信息自动更新——员工无需任何手动操作。

lines.en: Interesting. What kind of traction have you had so far?
lines.zh: 有意思。目前你们取得了什么样的进展？

lines.en: We launched in two cities six months ago. We now have 120 partner stores and around 40,000 active users.
lines.zh: 我们六个月前在两个城市上线，现在有120家合作门店，约4万名活跃用户。

lines.en: And how do you make money?
lines.zh: 那你们怎么盈利？

lines.en: We take a fifteen percent commission on each sale. Stores are happy because they're recovering revenue they'd otherwise lose entirely.
lines.zh: 我们对每笔交易抽取15%佣金。商店也乐意，因为他们挽回了原本会完全损失的收入。

lines.en: I'd like to see your numbers in more detail. Can you send over your financials this week?
lines.zh: 我想更详细地看看你们的数据。这周能把财务资料发给我吗？

sentences.en: Habits, according to neuroscientists, are the brain's way of saving effort.
sentences.zh: 神经科学家认为，习惯是大脑节省力气的方式。

sentences.en: When a behaviour is repeated in a stable context, control gradually shifts from deliberate decision-making to more automatic processes.
sentences.zh: 当一种行为在稳定的情境中反复进行时，控制权会逐渐从有意识的决策转向更自动化的过程。

sentences.en: This is why it's so easy to reach for your phone the moment you wake up: the cue triggers the action before you've consciously thought about it.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么一醒来就很容易伸手拿手机：在你有意识地思考之前，提示就已触发了动作。

sentences.en: Contrary to the popular claim that a habit takes 21 days to form, one widely cited study found the average was closer to 66 days, with enormous variation between individuals.
sentences.zh: 与“21天养成一个习惯”的流行说法相反，一项被广泛引用的研究发现平均需要约66天，且个体差异极大。

sentences.en: Researchers suggest that the most effective strategy isn't relying on willpower, but redesigning your environment so that the desired behaviour becomes the easiest option.
sentences.zh: 研究人员认为，最有效的策略不是依靠意志力，而是重新设计环境，让理想的行为成为最容易的选择。

questions.q: What happens when a behaviour is repeated in a stable context?
questions.qZh: 当一种行为在稳定情境中重复时会怎样？

questions.q: What did the study find about habit formation?
questions.qZh: 关于习惯养成，研究发现了什么？

questions.q: What is described as the most effective strategy?
questions.qZh: 什么被认为是最有效的策略？

sentences.en: Of the roughly seven thousand languages spoken today, linguists estimate that around forty percent are endangered.
sentences.zh: 在当今使用的约七千种语言中，语言学家估计约有百分之四十濒临消失。

sentences.en: Many have only a handful of elderly speakers, and children are no longer learning them at home.
sentences.zh: 许多语言只剩寥寥几位年长的使用者，孩子们在家已不再学习它们。

sentences.en: When a language disappears, it takes with it unique ways of describing the world — from knowledge of local plants to systems of counting and kinship.
sentences.zh: 一种语言消失时，它独特的描述世界的方式也随之而去——从当地植物的知识到计数和亲属称谓体系。

sentences.en: Revitalisation efforts have had some striking successes; Welsh, for instance, now has more young speakers than it did a few decades ago.
sentences.zh: 语言复兴工作取得了一些显著成功；例如，威尔士语如今的年轻使用者比几十年前更多。

sentences.en: Technology is playing a growing role, with communities recording elders and building apps to teach vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 科技的作用日益增大，各社区纷纷为长者录音，并开发应用来教授词汇。

sentences.en: Yet experts stress that no app can replace a language being spoken naturally within families.
sentences.zh: 然而专家强调，任何应用都无法取代语言在家庭中被自然使用。

questions.q: Roughly what proportion of languages are endangered?
questions.qZh: 大约多大比例的语言濒临消失？

questions.q: Which language is given as a success story?
questions.qZh: 哪种语言被举为成功案例？

questions.q: What do experts say about technology?
options: It cannot replace use within families

sentences.en: We tend to assume that more options make us happier, but a famous experiment suggested otherwise.
sentences.zh: 我们往往以为选择越多越幸福，但一个著名实验却表明并非如此。

sentences.en: Shoppers who were offered a sample of 24 jams were far less likely to buy one than those offered just six.
sentences.zh: 面对24种果酱试吃的顾客，购买的可能性远低于只面对6种的顾客。

sentences.en: The explanation was that too many options lead to decision fatigue and a fear of choosing wrongly.
sentences.zh: 解释是：选项过多会导致决策疲劳和害怕选错。

sentences.en: Later research, however, has produced mixed results, and the effect seems to depend heavily on context.
sentences.zh: 然而后来的研究结果不一，这种效应似乎在很大程度上取决于情境。

sentences.en: When people already know what they want, a wide range is genuinely helpful; when they don't, it can be paralysing.
sentences.zh: 当人们已经清楚自己想要什么时，丰富的选择确实有帮助；当他们不清楚时，选择多反而会让人无所适从。

questions.q: In the experiment, which group bought more jam?
questions.qZh: 实验中哪组人买的果酱更多？
后来的研究表明了什么？

questions.q: When is a wide range of options helpful?
questions.qZh: 什么时候丰富的选择有帮助？
options: When people know what they want

sentences.en: For a long time, sleep was thought of as a passive state, a kind of switching off.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，睡眠被认为是一种被动状态，类似于关机。

sentences.en: We now know that the brain is remarkably active during the night, particularly when it comes to memory.
sentences.zh: 现在我们知道大脑在夜间非常活跃，尤其是在记忆方面。

sentences.en: During deep sleep, the hippocampus appears to replay experiences from the day, helping to transfer them into long-term storage.
sentences.zh: 在深度睡眠中，海马体似乎会重放白天的经历，帮助把它们转入长期存储。

sentences.en: Students who sleep after studying consistently outperform those who stay up, even when total study time is the same.
sentences.zh: 学习后睡觉的学生，表现一直优于熬夜的学生，即使总学习时间相同。

sentences.en: So the all-nighter before an exam may be one of the least effective revision strategies there is.
sentences.zh: 所以考前通宵可能是效果最差的复习策略之一。

questions.qZh: 过去人们如何看待睡眠？

questions.q: What does the hippocampus seem to do during deep sleep?
questions.qZh: 深度睡眠时海马体似乎在做什么？
关于通宵复习说了什么？
options: They are among the least effective strategies

news.title: Climate change behind most of Europe's summer heat deaths
news.titleZh: 欧洲夏季高温死亡大多归因于气候变化

sentences.en: A newly published study has put the death toll from this summer's heatwaves across Europe at roughly 50,000.
sentences.zh: 一项新发表的研究将今夏欧洲热浪造成的死亡人数估计为约5万人。

sentences.en: Crucially, the researchers attribute around two-thirds of those deaths to human-caused climate change.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，研究人员将其中约三分之二的死亡归因于人为造成的气候变化。

sentences.en: Their analysis drew on data from 854 cities, which means that deaths in rural areas were not captured.
sentences.zh: 他们的分析基于854座城市的数据，这意味着农村地区的死亡并未被统计在内。

sentences.en: As a result, the authors caution that the true figure is almost certainly higher.
sentences.zh: 因此，作者提醒，真实数字几乎肯定更高。

sentences.en: Unlike floods or storms, heatwaves rarely cause visible destruction, so their human cost often goes underreported.
sentences.zh: 与洪水或风暴不同，热浪很少造成肉眼可见的破坏，因此其人员代价常被低估。

sentences.en: Most victims are elderly people or those with existing health conditions, many of whom die alone at home.
sentences.zh: 大多数遇难者是老年人或有基础疾病的人，其中许多人独自在家中去世。

sentences.en: Public health experts argue that heat should be treated as a major disaster risk, with dedicated warning systems and cooling centres.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生专家主张，应将高温视为重大灾害风险，配备专门的预警系统和避暑中心。

news.title: Alpine glaciers past 'peak water', scientists warn
news.titleZh: 科学家警告：阿尔卑斯冰川已越过“融水峰值”

sentences.en: Swiss glaciers shed 5.5 percent of their remaining volume over the past year, bringing their losses since 2021 to almost a fifth.
sentences.zh: 瑞士冰川在过去一年失去了剩余体积的5.5%，使其自2021年以来的损失接近五分之一。

sentences.en: The figures come from the national monitoring network GLAMOS, whose teams take end-of-summer measurements on dozens of glaciers.
sentences.zh: 这些数据来自国家监测网络GLAMOS，其团队在夏末对数十座冰川进行测量。

sentences.en: A winter with scant snowfall left the ice exposed, and a record-breaking summer did the rest.
sentences.zh: 降雪稀少的冬季让冰面裸露，破纪录的夏季则完成了剩下的“工作”。

sentences.en: In some places, glacier tongues dropped by as much as ten metres in a single season.
sentences.zh: 在某些地方，冰舌在一个季节内下降了多达十米。

sentences.en: Beyond tourism, the losses matter because glacial meltwater feeds hydropower reservoirs and major European rivers.
sentences.zh: 除了旅游业，这些损失之所以重要，是因为冰川融水为水电站水库和欧洲主要河流提供水源。

sentences.en: One glaciologist warned that Alpine glaciers have already passed their peak meltwater supply, meaning summer flows will steadily decline.
sentences.zh: 一位冰川学家警告，阿尔卑斯冰川已越过融水供应峰值，这意味着夏季流量将持续下降。

sentences.en: Projections suggest that rapid emissions cuts could preserve about a third of the ice, while strong warming could wipe out more than 90 percent by 2100.
sentences.zh: 预测显示，快速减排可保住约三分之一的冰量，而强烈升温则可能在2100年前使九成以上的冰消失。

news.title: Light-controlled muscle robot navigates a maze
news.titleZh: 光控肌肉机器人穿越迷宫

sentences.en: Researchers at MIT have developed a soft swimming robot propelled by living skeletal muscle rather than motors.
sentences.zh: 麻省理工学院的研究人员开发出一种软体游泳机器人，它由活体骨骼肌而非马达驱动。

sentences.en: The device consists of a gel film roughly half a millimetre thick, with a layer of muscle thinner than a human hair on each fin.
sentences.zh: 该装置由约半毫米厚的凝胶薄膜构成，每个鳍上有一层比头发还细的肌肉。

sentences.en: The cells were genetically engineered to contract in response to light, allowing each fin to be controlled independently.
sentences.zh: 这些细胞经过基因改造，能在光照下收缩，从而可以独立控制每个鳍。

sentences.en: By flashing light on one fin or the other at different intervals, the team could adjust both the robot's speed and its direction.
sentences.zh: 通过以不同间隔向某一侧的鳍闪光，团队可以同时调整机器人的速度和方向。

sentences.en: Grooves stamped into the gel helped the muscle cells align into stronger fibres, increasing the force they produced.
sentences.zh: 压印在凝胶上的凹槽帮助肌肉细胞排列成更强壮的纤维，提高了产生的力量。

sentences.en: Guided by a hand-held light, the robot swam through a small water maze at up to four body lengths per minute.
sentences.zh: 在手持光源的引导下，机器人以每分钟最多四个身长的速度游过了一个小型水中迷宫。

sentences.en: The researchers envisage such biohybrid machines being used for delicate tasks such as environmental monitoring.
sentences.zh: 研究人员设想将这类生物混合机器用于环境监测等精细任务。
